players.product: data center buildings owned and operated for GPU clusters (owner / operator of the Columbus, Georgia site hosting Axe Compute's B300 cluster)

quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 10-Q: Technology Solutions became the largest source of revenue from continuing operations in Q2 2026, with demand driven by data center construction and modernization tied to AI adoption and growing customer prepayments; contract liabilities reached $21,248,180 at June 30, 2026, including $18,770,228 of Data Center Hosting billings. Two customers accounted for 43% and 10% of first-half 2026 revenue (79% and 21% a year earlier). Data Center Hosting segment assets grew to $102,393,324 from $28,024,994 at December 31, 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: contract liabilities $21,248,180; customers 43% and 10% of H1 revenue; Data Center Hosting assets $102,393,324

quarterly_data.signal: Duos Technologies 10-Q: Duos has a master service agreement with Hydra Host, Inc. under which Hydra Host, as operator, arranges purchases of GPU servers, networking equipment and related infrastructure from vendors, configures, installs, operates and maintains the servers on Duos' behalf and secures a customer; the aggregate estimated cost of these commitments was approximately $145 million at June 30, 2026, and the Columbus GPUs will be operated by Hydra Host for a third-party client. The Columbus, Georgia facility purchase closed after quarter end, with additional power capacity of up to 15 MW to be delivered in 5 MW increments.
quarterly_data.figure: GPU commitments approximately $145 million; up to 15 MW in 5 MW increments
